blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Jose Rizal University leaned on Laurence Mangubat and the late heroics of Sean Salvador to outlast Mapua in its NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball opener on Monday. Mangubat led the Heavy Bombers with 22 points, seven rebounds and five steals, but it was Salvador who made the biggest shot of the game. Hounded by the Cardinals’ defense, Mangubat found an open Salvador in the right corner and never doubted his teammate.
